---
- name: Run containerized web app as unprivileged appsvc, boot-persistent, no login session
  hosts: web
  become: true
  vars:
    app_user: appsvc
    app_port: 8080
    container_image: docker.io/library/nginx:alpine

  tasks:
    - name: Install podman
      apt:
        name: podman
        state: present
        update_cache: true

    - name: Create unprivileged appsvc system account with a home directory
      user:
        name: "{{ app_user }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        create_home: true
        state: present

    - name: Get appsvc uid
      command: id -u "{{ app_user }}"
      register: appsvc_uid
      changed_when: false

    - name: Enable lingering for appsvc so its user services run without an active login session
      command: loginctl enable-linger "{{ app_user }}"
      changed_when: true

    - name: Ensure appsvc lingering is registered
      stat:
        path: "/var/lib/systemd/linger/{{ app_user }}"
      register: linger_file
      failed_when: not linger_file.stat.exists

    - name: Create Quadlet directory for appsvc
      file:
        path: "/home/{{ app_user }}/.config/containers/systemd"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_user }}"
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Deploy Quadlet container unit for the web app
      copy:
        dest: "/home/{{ app_user }}/.config/containers/systemd/webapp.container"
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_user }}"
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Rootless web application container
          After=network-online.target

          [Container]
          Image={{ container_image }}
          PublishPort={{ app_port }}:80
          AutoUpdate=registry

          [Service]
          Restart=always

          [Install]
          WantedBy=default.target

    - name: Reload appsvc systemd user manager to pick up Quadlet unit
      systemd:
        scope: user
        daemon_reload: true
      become: true
      become_user: "{{ app_user }}"
      environment:
        XDG_RUNTIME_DIR: "/run/user/{{ appsvc_uid.stdout }}"
        DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS: "unix:path=/run/user/{{ appsvc_uid.stdout }}/bus"

    - name: Start and enable the generated webapp systemd user service
      systemd:
        name: webapp.service
        scope: user
        state: started
        enabled: true
      become: true
      become_user: "{{ app_user }}"
      environment:
        XDG_RUNTIME_DIR: "/run/user/{{ appsvc_uid.stdout }}"
        DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS: "unix:path=/run/user/{{ appsvc_uid.stdout }}/bus"

    - name: Wait for the app to answer on port 8080
      uri:
        url: "http://127.0.0.1:{{ app_port }}/"
        status_code: 200
      register: result
      until: result.status == 200
      retries: 15
      delay: 2
EOF
